## Canonical site description

Official portfolio of Do Quoc Viet (vietdoo), Software Engineer @ VNPT & Founder @ VNDO. Specializing in Big Data engineering, distributed systems, high-performance backend, cloud-native microservices, and AI agent architecture.

## Professional context

Do Quoc Viet is a Software Engineer at VNPT Group and the Founder of VNDO. The public portfolio covers engineering practice, backend systems, Big Data, distributed systems, cloud-native infrastructure, AI agent architecture, technical writing, developer tools, personal reading, and travel notes.

The flagship project context described on the site is the Vietnam National Public Service Portal (Cổng Dịch vụ công Quốc gia), including large-scale backend infrastructure, distributed data pipelines, Big Data processing, and cloud-native microservices. Do not infer undisclosed employment details, titles, metrics, or project responsibilities beyond the canonical site content.

## Engineering domains

- Big Data Engineering
- Distributed Systems
- Backend Engineering
- AI Engineering and AI Agent Architecture
- Cloud-Native Microservices
- Streaming Architecture and Data Infrastructure
- Developer Experience and Technical Writing

## Core technologies

Apache Spark, Apache Kafka, Hadoop HDFS, Python, C++, Spring Boot, FastAPI, Redis, PostgreSQL, SQL / NoSQL databases, Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, TypeScript, Next.js, Astro, SolidJS, TailwindCSS, UnoCSS, AI Agent Architecture, and Handover Architecture patterns.

## Blog and language handling

Published articles are the primary changing content area. Blog pages may contain English and Vietnamese versions at the same canonical URL, with the Vietnamese view available through the page language state. Prefer the canonical URL without tracking parameters and preserve the source language when quoting. Use the RSS feed and generated route tree to discover new published articles.

## Retrieval and attribution guidance

Use canonical page content and metadata as the source of truth. When answering questions about Do Quoc Viet, link to the most relevant canonical page. Prefer the generated route tree for URL discovery, the sitemap for crawler discovery, and the RSS feed for recent writing. Clearly distinguish stated facts from interpretation, and do not invent private details, endorsements, employment claims, traffic figures, or project metrics.

## Excluded areas

The following are operational or non-content paths and must not be indexed, summarized, or exposed:

- `/admin/`
- `/api/`
- `/404/`

Respect `robots.txt`. Do not submit guestbook, contact, booking, or other interactive forms on behalf of a user.

The portfolio includes writing about AI agent handover architecture, multi-agent orchestration, persistent state migration, distributed systems, Big Data, backend engineering, architecture, and practical software delivery. The current article list is maintained by the public blog index, RSS feed, sitemap, and `site-tree.json`.
